@graph.description: Every question of the buyer-intent rubric — 518217 rows generated from the rubric database, never hand-kept — with its intent class, service, geo scope, target page, money weight, Answer Panel membership state, and its fragment-binding state: bound exactly to the fragment that should answer it, covered at page level, or carrying no fragment on its target page yet. The full question rows are published in the companion files datasets-answer-evidence-questions.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-2.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-3.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-4.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-5.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-6.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-7.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-8.json, datasets-answer-evidence-questions-9.json (this node in those files, at the same @id, carries the array, split in rubric order into byte-balanced parts under the hosting per-file size cap); this file carries the counts and the references, so no file crosses the hosting per-file size limit as the rubric grows. This file carries part 5 of 9 of the array — rows 229244–286014 of 518217 in rubric order; the 9 parts in file order are the full array. Rows omit a field whose value is the default: panelState defaults to “not a panel question.”, panelMember to false, owningFragmentId to null and moneyWeight to “standard”; non-default values are carried verbatim.
